verdict.rationale: Fern Agent automations operate by reading the docs site's source repo and opening a pull request when changes are needed, which inherently gives git-based versioning and human review before merge (fern-docs-8/25/29). However, there's no dedicated automation-specific version history, audit log, or explicit one-click rollback/undo feature documented beyond relying on standard git revert via PRs. Missing for 10: explicit rollback/undo UI for automations, automation run history/audit trail, and any review workflow beyond generic PR review.
